__NOTOC__
<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="skills-training" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Skills Training</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Some skills are a vital part of your character's PvM strength. Here we go over some of the ways to train the skills and what they unlock. </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Full skilling guides for every skill can be found on the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Skill_training_guides <nowiki>Wiki</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="prayer"><ins><nowiki>Prayer</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 46 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for protection prayers that halve that type of damage received.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>70 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /></strong><nowiki> - best DPS prayers on the normal prayer book </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215399597581533264.png?v=1" alt="Piety" title="Piety" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215399596239618118.png?v=1" alt="Rigour" title="Rigour" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799720926478437.png?v=1" alt="augury" title="augury" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941000636092467.png?v=1" alt="sanctity" title="sanctity" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unlocked after completing </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/King%27s_Ransom/Quick_guide <nowiki>King's Ransom</nowiki>]<nowiki> and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Knight_Waves_training_ground <nowiki>knight training</nowiki>]<nowiki>, for when you start PvMing or bossing.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>92-95 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Curses</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Requires completion of </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Temple_at_Senntisten/Quick_guide <nowiki>The Temple at Senntisten</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unlocks </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> which heals you based on damage dealt.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Gives access to strong DPS curses </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1" alt="turmoil" title="turmoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1" alt="anguish" title="anguish" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1" alt="sorrow" title="sorrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, which should be your primary long-term goal.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Primarily train </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> by burying bones with </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Powder_of_burials <nowiki>powder of burials</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/989191014738698340.png?v=1" alt="powderofburials" title="powderofburials" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Suggested </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> quests &amp; training</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-43: Do: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Restless_ghost_quick_guide <nowiki>Restless Ghost</nowiki>]<nowiki>, </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Priest_in_Peril/Quick_guide <nowiki>Priest in Peril</nowiki>]<nowiki>, and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/One_Piercing_Note/Quick_guide <nowiki>One Piercing Note</nowiki>]<nowiki> → </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Holy_Cithara#Obtaining_the_Holy_Cithara <nowiki>Holy Cithara</nowiki>]<nowiki> (if Desert Treasure completed) quests and then </nowiki><strong>[https://runescape.wiki/w/God_Statues <nowiki>God Statues</nowiki>]</strong><nowiki> monthly D&amp;D. Then:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-95 Cheap: Offer Infernal ashes at </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Chaos_altar_(Wilderness) <nowiki>Chaos Altar</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-70: Bury dragon bones with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/989191014738698340.png?v=1" alt="powderofburials" title="powderofburials" kind="icon" /><nowiki> active</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 70-95: Bury dinosaur bones with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/989191014738698340.png?v=1" alt="powderofburials" title="powderofburials" kind="icon" /><nowiki> active</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="summoning"><ins><nowiki>Summoning</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1" alt="Summoning" title="Summoning" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Summoning allows you to summon helpful familiars for to aid you in combat via extra inventory, healing, or dealing damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: This assumes you already have the charms needed from other PvM content. The list of familiars suggested below is only a recommendation.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Check </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1" alt="summoning" title="summoning" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculators#Summoning <nowiki>Wiki calculators</nowiki>]<nowiki> for up-to-date pricing.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The weekly Familiarisation minigame can be beneficial when farming charms (triple charms for up to 40 minutes).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Charming potions add +1 charms dropped when killing things</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, and are tradeable on the GE - use them when gathering charms for training summoning!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Arch-Glacor#Normal_mode <nowiki>Arch glacor 0-1 mechanics</nowiki>]<nowiki> is a low-level boss that drops a lot of blue charms.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Suggested pouches to craft</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-4 : Do the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Wolf_Whistle/Quick_guide <nowiki>Wolf Whistle</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 4-16: Dreadfowls</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 16-32: Granite Crabs</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 32-46: Honeybadgers</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 46-49: Pyrelords</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 49-61: Bloated Leeches</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 61-64: Smoke Devils or Bloated Leeches</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 64-74: Stranger Plants or Smoke Devils</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 74-79: Granite Lobsters</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 79-89: Moss Titans</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 89-99: Geyser titans</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="herblore"><ins><nowiki>Herblore</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1" alt="Herblore" title="Herblore" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Herblore </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1" alt="herblore" title="herblore" kind="icon" /><nowiki> grants you access to untradeable potions such as </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Overload <nowiki>Overloads</nowiki>]<nowiki> (96+ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1" alt="herblore" title="herblore" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for combat skill boosting, and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Adrenaline_potion#(4) <nowiki>adrenaline potions</nowiki>]<nowiki> (84+ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1" alt="herblore" title="herblore" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) for more adrenaline on-demand.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: prices of supplies and potions fluctuate. Making certain potions may even be profitable. Do some research before training.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1" alt="herblore" title="herblore" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculators#Herblore <nowiki>Wiki calculators</nowiki>]<nowiki> for research.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Warbands <nowiki>Warbands</nowiki>]<nowiki> are one option for relatively fast and free Herblore XP, but may require some time investment to learn, and are located in the Wilderness.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• unavailable for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/764086050959392778.png?v=1" alt="iron" title="iron" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Herby_Werby <nowiki>Herby Werby</nowiki>]<nowiki> has no requirements and can be done after visiting </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Anachronia/Quick_guide <nowiki>Anachronia</nowiki>]<nowiki> once. Buy </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_seed <nowiki>ancient seeds</nowiki>]<nowiki> to return weekly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You can choose to wait for a </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Double_XP_Live <nowiki>DXP (Double XP) weekend</nowiki>]<nowiki> to train.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Always make use of portable wells when making potions for the +10% experience boost.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Suggested training methods</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-38: Do Warbands daily, Herby-Werby weekly or the highest level potion available</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 38-52: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Prayer_potion <nowiki>Prayer potions</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 52-66: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Super_Energy_potion <nowiki>Super Energy potions</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 66-84: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Super_Defence_potion <nowiki>Super Defence potions</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 84-88: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Adrenaline_potion <nowiki>Adrenaline potions</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 88-96: Make ~3000 of each </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Extreme_potion <nowiki>extreme potion</nowiki>]<nowiki>. Should that not be enough, just make some more adrenaline potions OR more extremes of equal amounts until you hit 96.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 96-99: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Overload <nowiki>Overloads</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 98-99: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Supreme_overload <nowiki>Supreme overloads</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ You can boost to 107 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1" alt="herblore" title="herblore" kind="icon" /><nowiki> via pulse core once you get to 99 in order to make </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Elder_overload_potion <nowiki>Elder overload potions</nowiki>]<nowiki>. These are the best-in-slot potions, and very worth the cost.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="slayer"><ins><nowiki>Slayer</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> may be less </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1" alt="combat" title="combat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> xp/hr than other methods; but comes with other benefits like making some </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1" alt="coins" title="coins" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, unlocking new monsters to kill, collecting charms for Summoning </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1" alt="Summoning" title="Summoning" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while training your combat stats all at the same time.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you choose to do Slayer, prioritise completing the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Smoking_Kills/Quick_guide <nowiki>Smoking Kills</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest. This doubles your point rewards from tasks. Then remember to quickly get a </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Full_slayer_helmet <nowiki>Full Slayer Helmet</nowiki>]<nowiki> for the big accuracy and damage boost it provides for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Make sure to use the highest available </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_Masters#Overview <nowiki>Slayer Master</nowiki>]<nowiki> to get the best tasks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Early on, you can quickly train slayer by squishing Corrupted Scarabs at Menaphos.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See the </nowiki><code><nowiki>soulobby</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎FC for calls on when scarabs spawn.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Fast/expensive </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> training method:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kill </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_demon_berserker <nowiki>greater demon berserkers</nowiki>]<nowiki> with </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_Wildcard <nowiki>Slayer wildcards</nowiki>]<nowiki> to 115 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Safespottable and even at lower levels this is very high xp/h.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="crafting"><ins><nowiki>Crafting</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864810239705119.png?v=1" alt="crafting" title="crafting" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>80 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864810239705119.png?v=1" alt="crafting" title="crafting" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is required for Invention </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="invention" title="invention" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and also up to 85 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864810239705119.png?v=1" alt="crafting" title="crafting" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to craft </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> armour.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: gp/xp calculations can be found on the Wiki page for training Crafting.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864810239705119.png?v=1" alt="crafting" title="crafting" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculators#Crafting <nowiki>Wiki calculators</nowiki>]<nowiki> for research.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Free/slow/cheap training methods</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 1+: dungeoneering crafting (craft magic/ranged armour in Daemonheim, sell them to the smuggler and buy more supplies, repeat).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 1+: crafting urns</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 1+ weekly clan citadel contribution at loom plot</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 75+: Prifddinas harps</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Fast/pricey training methods</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 20+: Cutting gems (sapphire/ruby/emerald/diamond)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 54+: Crafting battlestaves</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 63+: Crafting dragonhide armour</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="divination"><ins><nowiki>Divination</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1042453694735712286.png?v=1" alt="divination" title="divination" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>80 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1042453694735712286.png?v=1" alt="divination" title="divination" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is required for Invention </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="invention" title="invention" kind="icon" /></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The best way to train Divination early on is through daily activities</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-80: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Guthixian_Cache <nowiki>Guthixian Caches</nowiki>]<nowiki> (start doing Caches ASAP - at low level, do them on legacy worlds, as there will be fewer people so you can Cres more often).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 70-80: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Hall_of_Memories <nowiki>Hall of Memories</nowiki>]<nowiki> (use </nowiki><code><nowiki>corehunting</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎FC for the most efficient method of training here - they also have a Discord server if you are interested).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="smithing"><ins><nowiki>Smithing</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864814379466812.png?v=1" alt="smithing" title="smithing" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>80 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864814379466812.png?v=1" alt="smithing" title="smithing" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is required for Invention </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="invention" title="invention" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and also up to 85 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864814379466812.png?v=1" alt="smithing" title="smithing" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to craft </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> weapons.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: gp/xp calculations and more details can be found on the Wiki page for training Smithing.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864814379466812.png?v=1" alt="smithing" title="smithing" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculators#Smithing <nowiki>Wiki calculators</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>80 Smithing is required for Invention </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="invention" title="invention" kind="icon" /></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/764086050959392778.png?v=1" alt="iron" title="iron" kind="icon" /><nowiki> may benefit from saving armour for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="invention" title="invention" kind="icon" /><nowiki> disassembling, or smithing full sets for </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Pay-to-play_Smithing_training#Forging_burial_armour <nowiki>burial armour</nowiki>]<nowiki> on w70.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Suggested training methods</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-30: Do </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Knight%27s_Sword/Quick_guide <nowiki>The Knight's Sword</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest, then make steel platebodies +1</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 30-40: Make mithril platebodies +2</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 40-50: Make adamant platebodies +2</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 50-60: Make rune platebodies +3</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 60-70: Make orikalkum platebodies +3</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 70-80: Make necrite platebodies +4</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="invention"><ins><nowiki>Invention</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="Invention" title="Invention" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Invention unlocks the ability to use perks on gear, which adds a huge amount of DPS, skilling utility and survivability.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: see </nowiki><span><nowiki>#invention-basics</nowiki></span><nowiki> for more information.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Suggested training methods</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1-4: Complete the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Invention_tutorial <nowiki>Invention tutorial</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 4-27: Research max item level 5, and disassemble two items at level 5 (cheap options like crystal halberd, black salamander, etc.)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 27-60: Research max item level 10, then disassemble items once they hit level 10.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 60-99/120: Disassemble (at level 10) or siphon (at level 12) weapons and armour while doing PvM/bossing and the skill will passively level up over time.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Shattered Worlds can be used to powerlevel invention, at the cost of combat experience</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See </nowiki><code><nowiki>!shatteredworlds</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎command for more information.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Item experience will be higher than AFK alternatives, but the combat experience will be significantly reduced.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="archaeology"><ins><nowiki>Archaeology</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1" alt="archaeology" title="archaeology" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Archaeology relics boost skilling and PvM in many ways, and is required for many important quests.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Do archaeology tutorial for + 500 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki> from </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698225967679930408.png?v=1" alt="fontoflife" title="fontoflife" kind="icon" /><nowiki> relic.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1" alt="archaeology" title="archaeology" kind="icon" /><nowiki> quest requirements:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ‎ ‎40 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1" alt="archaeology" title="archaeology" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Daughter_of_Chaos/Quick_guide <nowiki>Daughter of Chaos</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ part of </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Succession/Quick_guide <nowiki>Succession</nowiki>]<nowiki> questline for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1" alt="infernalpuzzlebox" title="infernalpuzzlebox" kind="icon" /><nowiki>).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/764086050959392778.png?v=1" alt="iron" title="iron" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: 68(b) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1" alt="archaeology" title="archaeology" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Dagon_Bye <nowiki>Dagon Bye</nowiki>]<nowiki> mystery for </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_Summoning <nowiki>ancient summoning</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 74 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1" alt="archaeology" title="archaeology" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/City_of_Senntisten/Quick_guide <nowiki>City of Senntisten</nowiki>]<nowiki> for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1" alt="animatedead" title="animatedead" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1" alt="exsanguinate" title="exsanguinate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1" alt="incitefear" title="incitefear" kind="icon" /><nowiki> spells.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ part of </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Extinction/Quick_guide <nowiki>Extinction</nowiki>]<nowiki> questline for passive ring of vigour </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1" alt="rov" title="rov" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 86 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1" alt="archaeology" title="archaeology" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Tomes_of_the_Warlock/Quick_guide <nowiki>Tomes of the Warlock</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest. Necromancy questline for talent tree incantations </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1" alt="lifetransfer" title="lifetransfer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1" alt="darkness" title="darkness" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1" alt="greaterboneshield" title="greaterboneshield" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 56-112 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1" alt="archaeology" title="archaeology" kind="icon" /><nowiki> important for high-lvl pvm relics </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808774106185768.png?v=1" alt="berserkersfury" title="berserkersfury" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773917573233.png?v=1" alt="furyofthesmall" title="furyofthesmall" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808774068699286.png?v=1" alt="deathward" title="deathward" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/739965637056659567.png?v=1" alt="persistentrage" title="persistentrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773711921195.png?v=1" alt="conservationofenergy" title="conservationofenergy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="dungeoneering"><ins><nowiki>Dungeoneering</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947795541143632.png?v=1" alt="dungeoneering" title="dungeoneering" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Note: </nowiki><em><nowiki>As tokens are the limiting factor for most upgrades, the farming of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1" alt="dungtoken" title="dungtoken" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is the focus of this subsection.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Dungeoneering </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947795541143632.png?v=1" alt="dungeoneering" title="dungeoneering" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is a support skill that gives a plethora of </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Daemonheim_Rewards <nowiki>rewards</nowiki>]<nowiki> to enhance your skilling and pvm (e.g. </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ring_of_vigour <nowiki>ring of vigour</nowiki>]<nowiki> and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Charming_imp <nowiki>Charming imp</nowiki>]<nowiki>) that can be bought with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1" alt="dungtoken" title="dungtoken" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ ‎ ‎</nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Dungeoneering#Preparing_for_a_dungeon <nowiki>Dungeoneering</nowiki>]<nowiki> can be trained by completing Daemonheim floors or by doing </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Elite_Dungeons <nowiki>Elite Dungeons</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="token-farming"><nowiki>Token </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1" alt="dungtoken" title="dungtoken" kind="icon" /><nowiki> farming</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>An efficient token </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1" alt="dungtoken" title="dungtoken" kind="icon" /><nowiki> farming method is killing minibosses in elite dungeons, which yields 5,000 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1" alt="dungtoken" title="dungtoken" kind="icon" /><nowiki> per kill.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Level 70+ stats and weapons are recommended.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Temple of Aminishi</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Tokens </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1" alt="dungtoken" title="dungtoken" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be farmed in the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Temple_of_Aminishi <nowiki>Temple of Aminishi</nowiki>]<nowiki> (ed1) on the first level solo up to trio (trio recommended). Click </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Dungeoneering_token/Strategies <nowiki>here</nowiki>]<nowiki> for strategies.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Miniboss spawns here are random. You can stretch your minimap to check for the miniboss icons.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When all have been killed, restart the dungeon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Cerberus Juvenile</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Alternatively, one can kill the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Cerberus_Juvenile <nowiki>Cerberus Juvenile</nowiki>]<nowiki> miniboss in the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Zamorakian_Undercity <nowiki>Zamorakian Undercity</nowiki>]<nowiki> (ed4) at the beginning, solo up to 5-man. You can safespot him by standing just outside the room.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• He always spawns.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• By using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> you can prevent luring the mages after the Mender passes, as shown </nowiki>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=500nAj3PcDw <nowiki>here</nowiki>]<nowiki>. Kill the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Chaos_witch_mender <nowiki>Chaos witch mender</nowiki>]<nowiki> after.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When Cerberus has been killed, restart the dungeon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: If the Mender aggros on you as you </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, the mages will be alerted!</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
      
    </nowiki>

</div>
